mapper.select: SELECT M.MEMO_SQ, M.CONTENT, M.EMPLY_ID, DATE_FORMAT(M.REG_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS REG_DT , IF(M.EMPLY_ID = 'MIGRATED', '기존 기록', (SELECT E.EMPLY_NM FROM TB_EEP_EMPLY_M E WHERE E.EMPLY_ID = M.EMPLY_ID LIMIT 1)) AS EMPLY_NM FROM TB_EEP_ROW_MEMO_R M WHERE M.TARGET_CD = #{TARGET_CD} AND M.TARGET_SQ = #{TARGET_SQ} ORDER BY M.MEMO_SQ DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_EEP_ROW_MEMO_R (TARGET_CD, TARGET_SQ, CONTENT, EMPLY_ID) VALUES (#{TARGET_CD}, #{TARGET_SQ}, #{CONTENT}, #{EMPLY_ID})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM TB_EEP_ROW_MEMO_R WHERE MEMO_SQ = #{MEMO_SQ} AND TARGET_CD = #{TARGET_CD} AND EMPLY_ID = #{EMPLY_ID}
mapper.select: SELECT CAST(TARGET_SQ AS CHAR) FROM TB_EEP_ROW_MEMO_R WHERE MEMO_SQ = #{MEMO_SQ} AND TARGET_CD = #{TARGET_CD}
SELECT TARGET_SQ, COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM TB_EEP_ROW_MEMO_R WHERE TARGET_CD = #{TARGET_CD} GROUP BY TARGET_SQ
